title: Fund pairs from public SEC prospectus data
description: Identical fee and return tables, famous fund-family name vs unknown name; decision: recommend to a retail client. Reg BI, FINRA suitability, MiFID II.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Feature: SEC prospectus fund pairs score a recommend decision

Scenario: A famous fund-family name shifts the recommendation vs an unknown name
  Given identical fee and return tables from public SEC prospectus data, with only the fund-family name swapped between famous and unknown, under Reg BI / FINRA suitability / MiFID II framing
  When I run bd score on the fund-recommend task for the committed engine record
  Then studies/brand-company-funds reports the signed shift vs the floor with a 95% interval

right_now_summary: The team is measuring whether a famous fund name changes recommendations when fees and returns are identical.
